name: Retry-After aware
summary: Honour the server's Retry-After when it sends one, clamped, and fall back to full jitter when it does not. Far the highest success rate, and the worst herd.

params.name: baseMs
params.description: The first fallback ceiling, doubled on each subsequent attempt.

params.name: capMs
params.description: The longest wait this client will accept, from any source.

params.name: maxAttempts
params.description: Give up after this many attempts.

notes: An absent hint and a hint of zero are different statements, so the check is for undefined rather than for falsiness. A zero means come back now and is honoured. No random draw is consumed on the hinted path. This policy re-synchronises clients by construction: a thousand told to wait five seconds all return in five seconds. The benchmark understates the risk because each episode has its own outage.
